title: Uniform committor bound below the boundary energy for overdamped Langevin dynamics
difficulty_reason: The authors adapt the cited capacity estimates to balls of radius depending on both h and x, explicitly check that the Harnack-chain constant is uniform, and combine a lower capacity bound along a decreasing-energy path with an upper bound from a boundary-level cutoff. The resulting h-dependent exponential bound is uniform on a compact sublevel set. The source explicitly credits the earlier capacity arguments and they are not represented as new here.
